name: Free Flower
source:
Main character graduates from high school in the city and returns to his hometown for the first time in three years. The landscape has not changed at all as if frozen in time. He is greeted by three childhood friends. Then he hears "welcome" and can't believe his eyes - there stands an important girl that should have died three years ago. And then the mysterious clock frozen three years ago starts to move again.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
